# BigQuery's quantified-path grammar requires an upper bound for bounded repetition.
# It permits omission of the lower bound only; an exact repetition uses {bound}.
# third_party/bigquery_docs/reference/standard-sql/graph-patterns.md
# Check rejection without asserting an undocumented diagnostic.
SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (a:Person)-[:Knows]->{1,}(b:Person) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> error:

SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH ANY SHORTEST (a:Person)-[:Knows]->{1,}(b:Person) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> error:

SELECT result FROM GRAPH_TABLE(scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH ((a:Person)-[:Knows]->(b:Person)){1,} RETURN COUNT(*) AS result)
=> error:

GRAPH scalar_graph.FinGraph MATCH (a:Person)-[:Knows]->{1,}(b:Person) RETURN COUNT(*) AS result
=> error:
